Lemma
[Asymptotics for linear phase] 1. ch4:4.5.3-lem-1\group Asymptotics If $a\in C_c^\infty (\R ^n)$ and $p e 0$, then for every integer $m\ge 1$, \[ \int _{\R ^n}e^{ip\cdot y/\varepsilon }a(y)\, dy=O(\varepsilon ^m). \]

Proof

\sketch Choose a coordinate with $p_1 e 0$ and integrate by parts $m$ times using

\[ e^{ip\cdot y/\varepsilon }=(\varepsilon /(ip_1))\partial _{y_1} e^{ip\cdot y/\varepsilon }. \]

□
